# AffordEgypt

> Budget-focused private travel services in Egypt, operated by Capital Travel Service (ETAA license 2179, operating since 2003; same team as Travel2Egypt). Transparent pricing in Egyptian pounds (EGP): a private car, a licensed Egyptologist guide, and per-person entrance tickets are priced separately, with no bundled markup. No online payment required — 10% deposit, balance on arrival.

Key facts:
- Private airport, intercity, and in-town transfers in Cairo, Luxor, Aswan, Hurghada, and Marsa Alam. Fixed prices by vehicle (sedan 1–2 passengers, minivan 3–8, van 9–15) and trip type (one-way, round trip, hourly).
- Licensed Egyptologist guides from 2,750 EGP/day (English; other languages priced higher).
- Guide + private car day packages from 5,625 EGP/day in Cairo.
- Live prices are quoted by the trip planner; the booked total always equals the quoted total.
- Contact: hello@affordegypt.com, or WhatsApp via the site.

## Booking
- [Trip planner](https://affordegypt.com/pricing-tool): build a multi-city itinerary with live per-item prices.
- [Transfers](https://affordegypt.com/transfers): book a single transfer without an itinerary.
